Our available panelists are Elliot, Rina, Sofia, and Tariq, and we need to select three of them. I want to make sure we're giving both candidates an equivalent opportunity to demonstrate their leadership capabilities.

commitments.detail: Panel will consist of Elliot, Sofia, and Tariq. Rina is excluded due to her close personal relationship with Jonah and informal coaching conflict of interest. Sofia and Tariq are included as they have no flagged process or relationship concerns. Elliot is included despite his four firsthand observations of Mara, which are not yet in the formal record, because excluding both Elliot and Rina would leave only two unflagged panelists and the panel requires three. Elliot's observations will be noted in the selection log for transparency.

Mara will receive the standardized interview questions at least 48 hours in advance and may submit written responses instead of answering verbally, per her documented accessibility need raised through the employee representative.

Jonah will receive an equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the same leadership criteria. The standardized question set will work for both written and verbal formats, and Jonah's format will be determined to ensure substantive fairness — not just procedural equality.

The selection packet will be updated to require a standardized question set and individual written score sheets from every panelist before the panel evaluates candidates. Sofia will help draft the standardized question set and score sheet template.

All stated considerations — Rina's conflict of interest, Elliot's four firsthand observations of Mara not in the formal record, the process gap on standardized questions and score sheets, and Mara's accessibility request — will be recorded in the selection log before the decision is finalized.

As a routine step before finalizing the internal selection, I will conduct a round-robin check with the hiring manager, peer manager, HR, and employee representative, recording each person's stated considerations in the selection log.
